stories.title: Meta agrees to report child-safety matters directly to Indian authorities

en.title: Meta agrees to report child-safety matters directly to Indian authorities
en.summary: Meta has agreed to report child safety issues directly to Indian authorities instead of routing reports through a US-based agency as it previously did.

stories.title: Meta to share child safety information directly with Indian agencies

en.title: Meta to share child safety information directly with Indian agencies
en.summary: Meta will now share child safety information directly with Indian agencies rather than sending it first to the US-based National Center for Missing & Exploited Children.

stories.title: Agartala-Delhi flight diverted to Lucknow after smoke warning; no injuries reported

en.title: Agartala-Delhi flight diverted to Lucknow after smoke warning; no injuries reported
en.summary: Flight 6E6504 from Agartala to Delhi was diverted to Lucknow Airport after a smoke warning. The aircraft landed safely with 103 passengers and 6 crew members with no incidents.

stories.title: Mumbai's Iconic Cafe Mondegar Loses Licence Over Food Safety, Hygiene Lapses

en.title: Mumbai's Iconic Cafe Mondegar Loses Licence Over Food Safety, Hygiene Lapses
en.summary: Cafe Mondegar, a well-known restaurant in Mumbai's Colaba area, has lost its operating licence due to violations related to food safety and hygiene standards.

stories.title: Six States, UT sign Kishau multipurpose project agreement; CM Sukhu hails ‘major victory’ for Himachal

en.title: Six States, UT sign Kishau multipurpose project agreement; CM Sukhu hails 'major victory' for Himachal
en.summary: Six states and a union territory have signed an agreement for the Kishau multipurpose project on the Tons river along the Uttarakhand-Himachal Pradesh border. Himachal Pradesh's Chief Minister described the development as a significant achievement for the state.

stories.title: India outclass Afghanistan again to seal T20I series with seven-wicket victory

en.title: India outclass Afghanistan again to seal T20I series with seven-wicket victory
en.summary: India defeated Afghanistan by seven wickets in a T20 International match, securing the series.

stories.title: Samson's 57 off 22 establishes his role of preferred opener as India seal series

en.title: Samson's 57 off 22 establishes his role of preferred opener as India seal series
en.summary: Sanju Samson scored 57 runs from 22 balls to lead India to victory and series triumph over Afghanistan, with support from Abhishek Sharma and strong bowling from Nitish Kumar Reddy.

stories.title: Samson slams 57 as India defeat Afghanistan, seal series with a match to spare

en.title: Samson slams 57 as India defeat Afghanistan, seal series with a match to spare
en.summary: India secured a T20 International series against Afghanistan with a match remaining, with Sanju Samson scoring 57 runs in the decisive victory.

stories.title: Cafe Mondegar, Maharashtra Biryani Center lose licences after FDA crackdown

en.title: Cafe Mondegar, Maharashtra Biryani Center lose licences after FDA crackdown
en.summary: Food safety authorities have revoked operating licenses for Cafe Mondegar and Maharashtra Biryani Center following regulatory enforcement action.

stories.title: 8-year deadlock ends as six states sign Kishau pact; Amit Shah says 10th water dispute resolved

en.title: 8-year deadlock ends as six states sign Kishau pact; Amit Shah says 10th water dispute resolved
en.summary: Six states have resolved an eight-year dispute by signing the Kishau pact, marking the resolution of India's tenth interstate water agreement.

stories.title: FDA suspends licences of Mumbai's iconic Cafe Mondegar, 3 others over safety violations

en.title: FDA suspends licences of Mumbai's iconic Cafe Mondegar, 3 others over safety violations
en.summary: Maharashtra food authorities suspended licenses for four establishments including Cafe Mondegar due to hygiene failures and unsafe food storage practices discovered during inspections.

stories.title: IndiGo Agartala-Delhi flight diverted to Lucknow after smoke warning in cargo area

en.title: IndiGo Agartala-Delhi flight diverted to Lucknow after smoke warning in cargo area
en.summary: An IndiGo flight carrying 103 passengers and six crew members diverted safely to Lucknow after a cargo area smoke alert; no smoke was found upon inspection.

stories.title: US 10-year Treasury bonds hit 19-year high ahead of Fed rate decision

en.title: US 10-year Treasury bonds hit 19-year high ahead of Fed rate decision
en.summary: US 10-year Treasury yields reached their highest levels since 2007, driven by rising oil prices and global inflation pressures. Investors expect the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates soon to address inflation concerns.

stories.title: New charges on UPI payments: Here's what you will be charged for stock market investments

en.title: New charges on UPI payments: Here's what you will be charged for stock market investments
en.summary: UPI payments for capital market transactions will incur a 0.02% Merchant Discount Rate capped at Rs 300, covering mutual funds and securities. The fee is expected to have limited impact on long-term investors but greater effect on frequent traders.

stories.title: Sebi plans shorter disaster recovery drills, stronger backup rules for exchanges

en.title: Sebi plans shorter disaster recovery drills, stronger backup rules for exchanges
en.summary: Sebi has proposed enhanced business continuity and disaster recovery requirements for market infrastructure institutions, including more frequent drills, improved data centre testing, and stronger recovery mechanisms. These measures aim to improve resilience against operational disruptions.

stories.title: CAS crash: Nifty plunges 462 points in less than 30 seconds. Will Sebi’s review break trend?

en.title: CAS crash: Nifty plunges 462 points in less than 30 seconds. Will Sebi's review break trend?
en.summary: Nifty experienced a sharp 2% drop in indicative price during the closing auction session before recovering. Sebi is proposing changes to expiry-day settlement and trading mechanisms amid concerns over the new CAS system.

stories.title: Will NSE be allowed to trade on NSE? Stock exchange may seek Sebi’s nod after listing

en.title: Will NSE be allowed to trade on NSE? Stock exchange may seek Sebi's nod after listing
en.summary: NSE is considering requesting regulatory approval to allow its shares to trade on its own platform following its IPO, even though it will be formally listed on BSE. This approach would potentially increase investor access while maintaining regulatory supervision.
